item.endrem.mechanical_eye.description: A brass-bound eye built from Create precision mechanisms - it hums with clockwork intent, as if calculating the way to the End.
item.endrem.industrial_eye.description: An early-machine-age eye wired with analog circuits - its gaze feels measured, regulated, and faintly electric.
item.endrem.lunar_eye.description: A pale eye set in Stellaris Moon Rock - it carries the cold silence of the Moon and glimmers like dust under starlight.
item.endrem.mars_eye.description: A red stone eye forged from the rough surface of Mars - it burns with dry heat and the restless pull of distant iron sands.
item.endrem.venus_eye.description: A golden eye shaped from Venus stone - it shimmers through a haze of alien heat.
item.endrem.soul_eye.description: A deep-blue eye infused with a Deeper and Darker Soul Crystal - it feels less like it points toward the End and more like it remembers it.
item.endrem.bee_eye.description: A honey-bright eye steeped in Bumblezone royal jelly - it gleams warmly, carrying the sweetness and authority of the hive.
item.endrem.holy_eye.description: Torn from the radiance of the Aether's Sun Spirit itself - a pack-original eye, not one of the 23 canonical eyes.
